# Q1: Rates of amyloid PET+ in CU ?
```{r Q1}
## Based on quarterly report from 25 Dec. 18th
## SA1 in R: baseline = earliest Amyloid_PET_Date per ID,
## CU defined as CohortAssgn == "CN",
## amyloid+ defined as Centiloids_wcbl > 18,
## plus Wilson 95% CI.

# ----------------------------
# 0) CONFIG: rename columns here if needed
# ----------------------------
colmap <- list(
  ID = "ID",
  Amyloid_PET_Date = "Amyloid_PET_Date",
  CohortAssgn = "CohortAssgn",
  Centiloids_wcbl = "Centiloids_wcbl"
)

ID     <- colmap$ID
DATE   <- colmap$Amyloid_PET_Date
COHORT <- colmap$CohortAssgn
CL     <- colmap$Centiloids_wcbl

# ----------------------------
# 1) Clean + parse date (YYYY-MM-DD)
# ----------------------------
a <- amy %>%
  mutate(
    ID_clean = trimws(as.character(.data[[ID]])),
    cohort_clean = trimws(as.character(.data[[COHORT]])),
    pet_date = as.Date(.data[[DATE]]),       # YYYY-MM-DD
    centiloid = as.numeric(.data[[CL]])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID_clean) & ID_clean != "")

# check parse fail
bad_date <- a %>% filter(is.na(pet_date) & !is.na(.data[[DATE]]))
cat(sprintf("[SA1] Date parse failures: %d rows\n", nrow(bad_date)))
if (nrow(bad_date) > 0) {
  print(bad_date %>% select(!!ID, !!DATE) %>% head(20))
}

# ----------------------------
# 2) Check CohortAssgn is stable (should be)
# ----------------------------
unstable <- a %>%
  group_by(ID_clean) %>%
  summarise(n_levels = n_distinct(na.omit(cohort_clean)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_levels > 1)

if (nrow(unstable) > 0) {
  print(head(unstable, 20))
}

# ----------------------------
# 3) Baseline = earliest PET date per ID (one record per ID)
# ----------------------------
sprintf("Missing PET date: %d",sum(is.na(amy$pet_date)))

baseline <- a %>%
  filter(!is.na(pet_date)) %>%
  arrange(ID_clean, pet_date, centiloid) %>%  
  group_by(ID_clean) %>%
  slice(1) %>%                                # earliest after sorting
  ungroup()

cat(sprintf("[SA1] Total baseline rows (unique IDs): %d\n", n_distinct(baseline$ID_clean)))

# ----------------------------
# 4) Amyloid+ in CN
# ----------------------------
cu <- baseline %>%
  filter(cohort_clean == "CN") %>%
  mutate(amy_pos = ifelse(is.na(centiloid), NA, centiloid > 18))

cu_valid <- cu %>% filter(!is.na(amy_pos))

n_cu       <- n_distinct(cu$ID_clean)
n_cu_valid <- n_distinct(cu_valid$ID_clean)
n_pos      <- sum(cu_valid$amy_pos)

prop <- if (n_cu_valid > 0) n_pos / n_cu_valid else NA_real_

cat(sprintf("[SA1] CU baseline (CN) unique IDs: %d\n", n_cu))
cat(sprintf("[SA1] CU baseline with non-missing CL: %d\n", n_cu_valid))
cat(sprintf("[SA1] CU baseline amyloid+ (CL>18): %d\n", n_pos))
if (!is.na(prop)) {
  cat(sprintf("[SA1] CU baseline amyloid+ rate: %.2f%%\n", 100 * prop))
} else {
  cat("[SA1] CU baseline amyloid+ rate: NA\n")
}

# ----------------------------
# 5) 95% CI - Exact binomial CI 
# ----------------------------
if (n_cu_valid > 0) {
  bt <- binom.test(n_pos, n_cu_valid)
  ci <- bt$conf.int
  cat(sprintf("[SA1] 95%% CI (binom.test): %.2f%% – %.2f%%\n", 100 * ci[1], 100 * ci[2]))
}
```
As of December 18, 2025, the amyloid positivity rate among cognitively normal participants was 10.42% (n = 10/96; 95% CI: 5.11–18.32%), based on wcbl Centiloid > 18.

```{R}
tau_matched <- sum(!is.na(tau_tagged$antiamy_tx_received))

cat(sprintf("[Tau] rows matched to internal flags: %d of %d\n", tau_matched, nrow(tau_tagged)))

tau_treated_rows <- sum(tau_tagged$antiamy_tx_received == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("[Tau] rows flagged treated (antiamy_tx_received==1): %d\n", tau_treated_rows))

# ----------------------------

# ----------------------------

tau_filt <- tau_tagged %>%

# ----------------------------

cat(sprintf("[Tau] rows after: %d | unique IDs: %d | rows removed: %d\n",
            nrow(tau_filt), n_distinct(tau_filt$ID_clean), nrow(tau_tagged) - nrow(tau_filt)))

# If you want to overwrite:
amy <- amy_filt
tau <- tau_filt
```

```{r}   

# ============================================================
# 1) dat
# ============================================================
colmap <- list(
  ID = "ID",
  CohortAssgn = "CohortAssgn",

  # Amyloid
  Amyloid_PET_Date = "Amyloid_PET_Date",
  Centiloids_wcbl = "Centiloids_wcbl",
  Centiloids_compositeref = "Centiloids_compositeref",

  # Tau
  Tau_PET_Date = "Tau_PET_Date",
  MetaROI_SUVR_infcblgm = "MetaROI_SUVR_infcblgm"
)

ID     <- colmap$ID
COHORT <- colmap$CohortAssgn

A_DATE <- colmap$Amyloid_PET_Date
A_Y1   <- colmap$Centiloids_wcbl
A_Y2   <- colmap$Centiloids_compositeref

T_DATE <- colmap$Tau_PET_Date
T_Y1   <- colmap$MetaROI_SUVR_infcblgm

amy_df <- amy
tau_df <- tau

# ============================================================
# 2) model
# ============================================================

amy_eoad_long <- amy_df %>%
  mutate(
    ID_clean = trimws(as.character(.data[[ID]])),
    cohort_clean = trimws(as.character(.data[[COHORT]])),
    visit_date = as.Date(.data[[A_DATE]]),  # expects YYYY-MM-DD
    Centiloids_wcbl = as.numeric(.data[[A_Y1]]),
    Centiloids_compositeref = as.numeric(.data[[A_Y2]])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID_clean) & ID_clean != "") %>%
  filter(cohort_clean == "EOAD") %>%
  filter(!is.na(visit_date)) %>%
  group_by(ID_clean) %>%
  arrange(visit_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    time_years = as.numeric(difftime(visit_date, first(visit_date), units = "days")) / 365.25,
    time_years = round(time_years, 2),    
    n_visits = n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_visits >= 2)

cat(sprintf("[SA2] Amyloid EOAD IDs with >=2 visits: %d\n", n_distinct(amy_eoad_long$ID_clean)))

tau_eoad_long <- tau_df %>%
  mutate(
    ID_clean = trimws(as.character(.data[[ID]])),
    cohort_clean = trimws(as.character(.data[[COHORT]])),
    visit_date = as.Date(.data[[T_DATE]]),  # expects YYYY-MM-DD
    MetaROI_SUVR_infcblgm = as.numeric(.data[[T_Y1]])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID_clean) & ID_clean != "") %>%
  filter(cohort_clean == "EOAD") %>%
  filter(!is.na(visit_date)) %>%
  group_by(ID_clean) %>%
  arrange(visit_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    time_years = as.numeric(difftime(visit_date, first(visit_date), units = "days")) / 365.25,
    time_years = round(time_years, 2),    
    n_visits = n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_visits >= 2)

cat(sprintf("[SA2] Tau EOAD IDs with >=2 visits: %d\n", n_distinct(tau_eoad_long$ID_clean)))

# ============================================================
# 3) random intercept model + getting slope
# ============================================================

fit_lme_ri <- function(df_long, outcome_col,
                       id_col = "ID_clean", time_col = "time_years",
                       method = "REML") {

  d <- df_long %>%
    select(all_of(c(id_col, time_col, outcome_col))) %>%
    rename(ID = all_of(id_col), time = all_of(time_col), y = all_of(outcome_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(y) & !is.na(time))

  m <- nlme::lme(
    fixed = y ~ time,
    random = ~ 1 | ID,
    data = d,
    method = method
  )

  tt <- summary(m)$tTable
  slope <- unname(tt["time", "Value"])
  se    <- unname(tt["time", "Std.Error"])
  pval  <- unname(tt["time", "p-value"])

  # Wald 95% CI
  ci_low  <- slope - 1.96 * se
  ci_high <- slope + 1.96 * se

  list(
    outcome = outcome_col,
    n_ids = n_distinct(d$ID),
    n_obs = nrow(d),
    model = m,
    slope = slope,
    se = se,
    p = pval,
    ci_low = ci_low,
    ci_high = ci_high,
    AIC = AIC(m),
    BIC = BIC(m)
  )
}

print_rate_lme <- function(fit_obj, label = NULL, digits = 3) {
  if (is.null(label)) label <- fit_obj$outcome
  cat("\n", "==== ", label, " (nlme::lme, RI only) ====\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("N IDs: %d | N obs: %d\n", fit_obj$n_ids, fit_obj$n_obs))
  cat(sprintf(
    "Slope: %.*f per year (SE %.*f), 95%% CI [%.*f, %.*f], p = %.2g\n",
    digits, fit_obj$slope, digits, fit_obj$se, digits, fit_obj$ci_low, digits, fit_obj$ci_high, fit_obj$p
  ))
  cat(sprintf("AIC: %.2f | BIC: %.2f\n", fit_obj$AIC, fit_obj$BIC))
}

# ============================================================
# 4) print
# ============================================================

fits_sa2 <- list()

# Amyloid (EOAD)
fits_sa2$amyloid_wcbl_ri <- fit_lme_ri(amy_eoad_long, "Centiloids_wcbl", method = "REML")
fits_sa2$amyloid_comp_ri <- fit_lme_ri(amy_eoad_long, "Centiloids_compositeref", method = "REML")

print_rate_lme(fits_sa2$amyloid_wcbl_ri, "Amyloid: Centiloids_wcbl")
print_rate_lme(fits_sa2$amyloid_comp_ri, "Amyloid: Centiloids_compositeref")

# Tau (EOAD)
fits_sa2$tau_metaROI_ri <- fit_lme_ri(tau_eoad_long, "MetaROI_SUVR_infcblgm", method = "REML")

print_rate_lme(fits_sa2$tau_metaROI_ri, "Tau: MetaROI_SUVR_infcblgm")

```
 
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5) Spaghetti plots + thick fixed-effect LME line
#    + 95% CI band for fixed effect line (Wald, from fixef/vcov)
#    + y-axis limits (CL: 0–200; SUVR: 1–4.5)
# ============================================================
 

# ---- helper: fixed-effect line + 95% CI band from nlme::lme ----
make_fixed_line_ci <- function(fit_obj, df_long,
                               time_col = "time_years",
                               n = 200, alpha = 0.05) {

  t_min <- min(df_long[[time_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  t_max <- max(df_long[[time_col]], na.rm = TRUE)

  newdat <- data.frame(time = seq(t_min, t_max, length.out = n))

  # fixed effects and their covariance
  beta <- nlme::fixef(fit_obj$model)             # (Intercept), time
  V    <- stats::vcov(fit_obj$model)             # 2x2 var-cov for fixed effects

  # design matrix for fixed effects
  X <- cbind(1, newdat$time)
  colnames(X) <- names(beta)

  # fitted mean
  newdat$y_hat <- as.numeric(X %*% beta)

  # SE of fitted mean at each time: sqrt(diag(X V X'))
  newdat$se_hat <- sqrt(diag(X %*% V %*% t(X)))

  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
  newdat$y_low  <- newdat$y_hat - z * newdat$se_hat
  newdat$y_high <- newdat$y_hat + z * newdat$se_hat

  newdat
}

# ---- helper: slope CI (Wald) from model summary (already in fit_obj)
fmt_slope_ci <- function(fit_obj, digits = 3) {
  sprintf("Slope = %.*f / year (95%% CI: %.*f, %.*f), p = %.2g",
          digits, fit_obj$slope, digits, fit_obj$ci_low, digits, fit_obj$ci_high, fit_obj$p)
}

# ---- helper: spaghetti + thick fixed line + CI ribbon ----
plot_spaghetti_with_lme_ci <- function(df_long, fit_obj,
                                       outcome_col,
                                       id_col = "ID_clean", time_col = "time_years",
                                       xlab = "Years from baseline",
                                       ylab = outcome_col,
                                       title = NULL,
                                       ylim = NULL) {

  d <- df_long %>%
    select(all_of(c(id_col, time_col, outcome_col))) %>%
    rename(ID = all_of(id_col), time = all_of(time_col), y = all_of(outcome_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ID) & !is.na(time) & !is.na(y)) %>%
    arrange(ID, time)

  fixed_line <- make_fixed_line_ci(fit_obj, d, time_col = "time", n = 200)

  subtitle_txt <- fmt_slope_ci(fit_obj, digits = 3)

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = time, y = y, group = ID)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 0.8) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = fixed_line,
      aes(x = time, ymin = y_low, ymax = y_high),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.18
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = fixed_line,
      aes(x = time, y = y_hat),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 1.4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle_txt,
      x = xlab,
      y = ylab
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  if (!is.null(ylim)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
  }

  p
}

# ----------------------------
# Amyloid: Centiloids_wcbl (y-range 0–200)
# ----------------------------
p_amy_wcbl <- plot_spaghetti_with_lme_ci(
  df_long = amy_eoad_long,
  fit_obj = fits_sa2$amyloid_wcbl_ri,
  outcome_col = "Centiloids_wcbl",
  ylab = "Centiloids (wcbl)",
  title = "EOAD Amyloid: Centiloids_wcbl (spaghetti + LME fixed effect ±95% CI)",
  ylim = c(0, 200)
)
print(p_amy_wcbl)

# ----------------------------
# Amyloid: Centiloids_compositeref (y-range 0–200)

p_amy_comp <- plot_spaghetti_with_lme_ci(
  df_long = amy_eoad_long,
  fit_obj = fits_sa2$amyloid_comp_ri,
  outcome_col = "Centiloids_compositeref",
  ylab = "Centiloids (composite ref)",
  title = "EOAD Amyloid: Centiloids_compositeref (spaghetti + LME fixed effect ±95% CI)",
  ylim = c(0, 200)
)
print(p_amy_comp)

# ----------------------------
# Tau: MetaROI_SUVR_infcblgm (y-range 1–4.5)
# ----------------------------
```

# Q3: Longitudinal change in tau PET in frontal vs temporal tau-PET ROI?
```{r}
#write.csv(tau_eoad_long,'tau_eoad_long_filtered_forROImodeling.csv')
# ============================================================
# GGSEG modeling (EOAD, tau_eoad_long): cortex (DK) + subcortex (aseg)
# Random intercept only: y ~ time_years + (1|ID)
# Extract fixed intercept + fixed slope per ROI
# ============================================================

 
df <- tau_eoad_long  # assumes you already created this (EOAD only, time_years, ID_clean)

id_col   <- "ID_clean"
time_col <- "time_years"

suvr_cols_all <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "_SUVR_infcblgm$")]

cort_cols <- suvr_cols_all[str_detect(suvr_cols_all, "^ctx_(lh|rh)_")]

subcort_cols <- setdiff(
  suvr_cols_all,
  cort_cols
)

cat(sprintf("Total SUVR columns ending _SUVR_infcblgm: %d\n", length(suvr_cols_all)))
cat(sprintf("Cortical ctx_lh/ctx_rh (DK): %d\n", length(cort_cols)))
cat(sprintf("Non-cortical (aseg/subcortical/other): %d\n", length(subcort_cols)))
print(subcort_cols)
# ----------------------------
# 2) Long format  
# ----------------------------
long_all <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(id_col, time_col, cort_cols, subcort_cols))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -all_of(c(id_col, time_col)),
    names_to = "roi",
    values_to = "y"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[id_col]]), !is.na(.data[[time_col]]), !is.na(y))

# Counts (from the actual modeling data)
counts_by_roi <- long_all %>%
  group_by(roi) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ids = n_distinct(.data[[id_col]]),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# 3) Fit RI LME per ROI (nlme::lme)
#     y ~ time + (1|ID) 
# ----------------------------
fit_one_roi <- function(dd) {
  # dd has columns: ID_clean, time_years, y
  m <- nlme::lme(
    fixed  = y ~ time_years,
    random = ~ 1 | ID_clean,
    data   = dd,
    method = "REML",
    na.action = na.omit,
    control = nlme::lmeControl(opt = "optim")
  )

  tt <- summary(m)$tTable
  b0 <- unname(tt["(Intercept)", "Value"])
  b0_se <- unname(tt["(Intercept)", "Std.Error"])
  b0_p  <- unname(tt["(Intercept)", "p-value"])

  b1 <- unname(tt["time_years", "Value"])
  b1_se <- unname(tt["time_years", "Std.Error"])
  b1_p  <- unname(tt["time_years", "p-value"])

  tibble(
    intercept = b0,
    intercept_se = b0_se,
    intercept_p = b0_p,
    slope = b1,
    slope_se = b1_se,
    slope_p = b1_p
  )
}

results <- long_all %>%
  group_by(roi) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    dd <- .x %>%
      transmute(
        ID_clean = .data[[id_col]],
        time_years = .data[[time_col]],
        y = y
      )

    # basic guardrails
    if (n_distinct(dd$ID_clean) < 3 || nrow(dd) < 10) {
      return(tibble(
        intercept = NA_real_, intercept_se = NA_real_, intercept_p = NA_real_,
        slope = NA_real_, slope_se = NA_real_, slope_p = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    out <- tryCatch(
      fit_one_roi(dd),
      error = function(e) tibble(
        intercept = NA_real_, intercept_se = NA_real_, intercept_p = NA_real_,
        slope = NA_real_, slope_se = NA_real_, slope_p = NA_real_
      )
    )
    out
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(counts_by_roi, by = "roi")

# Split cortex vs subcortex results
res_cortex <- results %>% filter(str_detect(roi, "^ctx_(lh|rh)_"))
res_subcort <- results %>% filter(!str_detect(roi, "^ctx_(lh|rh)_"))

cat(sprintf("\nModeled ROIs: cortex=%d | subcort/other=%d\n",
            nrow(res_cortex), nrow(res_subcort)))
```
